subject.title: [Feature]: Goal continuance — per-turn goal context + QA continuance scenarios

question: Should OpenClaw adopt bounded active-goal context on every active-goal turn, and should the linked PR remain the canonical implementation path after its session-context blockers are fixed?
rationale: This changes the prompt contract for every active `/goal` session and the issue carries the protected `maintainer` label, so automation should not choose the permanent behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt bounded active-goal context
options.body: Repair and land the linked PR so active goals are injected as current-turn user context with focused strip/replay and continuance QA coverage.

options.title: QA-only first
options.body: Add scenarios that expose the current continuance gap before deciding whether automatic active-goal injection is the right behavior.

options.title: Defer goal continuance
options.body: Keep goals as explicit `/goal` and tool state for now, accepting that later turns may need operator nudges.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded active-goal context
recommendation.body: Repair and land the linked PR so active goals are injected as current-turn user context with focused strip/replay and continuance QA coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current goal feature history and authored both this product follow-up and the candidate implementation PR.
